# Proxmox VE: References

Always prefer current Proxmox VE documentation; privileges, defaults, and menus change between releases.

Last verified: 2026-10-30

## Vendor (authoritative)

- Security advisories (Proxmox forum, per-product lists):
  https://forum.proxmox.com/threads/proxmox-virtual-environment-security-advisories.149331/
- Security advisory FAQ and how to report a vulnerability:
  https://forum.proxmox.com/threads/general-faq-about-proxmox-security-advisories.149328/
- Release notes and roadmap: https://pve.proxmox.com/wiki/Roadmap
- Support lifecycle (FAQ): https://pve.proxmox.com/wiki/FAQ
- Administration guide (all chapters): https://pve.proxmox.com/pve-docs/pve-admin-guide.html
- Package repositories (enterprise, no-subscription, test, Ceph): https://pve.proxmox.com/wiki/Package_Repositories
- User management (realms, TFA, roles, ACLs, API tokens): https://pve.proxmox.com/wiki/User_Management
- `pveum` man page: https://pve.proxmox.com/pve-docs/pveum.1.html
- Firewall (default state, ports, `management` IPSet, nftables backend): https://pve.proxmox.com/wiki/Firewall
- `pve-firewall` man page: https://pve.proxmox.com/pve-docs/pve-firewall.8.html
- `pveproxy` (allow/deny lists, listen address, certificates): https://pve.proxmox.com/pve-docs/pveproxy.8.html
- Backup and restore (jobs, modes, retention, protection): https://pve.proxmox.com/wiki/Backup_and_Restore
- `vzdump` man page: https://pve.proxmox.com/pve-docs/vzdump.1.html
- Proxmox Backup Server storage (client-side encryption keys, master key):
  https://pve.proxmox.com/wiki/Storage:_Proxmox_Backup_Server
- Linux containers (unprivileged vs privileged, AppArmor): https://pve.proxmox.com/wiki/Linux_Container
- QEMU guest agent: https://pve.proxmox.com/wiki/Qemu-guest-agent
- `qm` man page (guest agent commands, hookscripts): https://pve.proxmox.com/pve-docs/qm.1.html
- Cluster manager (corosync network, SSH, migration network and type): https://pve.proxmox.com/wiki/Cluster_Manager
- `datacenter.cfg` (including `mac_prefix`, migration settings): https://pve.proxmox.com/wiki/Manual:_datacenter.cfg
- Proxmox Backup Server documentation: https://pbs.proxmox.com/docs/

## Upstream

- Debian security advisories: https://www.debian.org/security/
- IEEE OUI registry (to confirm MAC prefix owners): https://regauth.standards.ieee.org/standards-ra-web/pub/view.html#registries

BMC vendors (Dell iDRAC, HPE iLO, Supermicro and others) publish their own security advisories and
hardening guides; use the current page for the specific server model.

Generic vulnerability and incident sources (CISA KEV, NVD, CVE, CISA ransomware guidance, IC3) are listed in
the core documents.

## Third-party (not authoritative)

- Thomas-Krenn wiki, Proxmox VE release overview: https://www.thomas-krenn.com/de/wiki/Proxmox_VE
  Convenient release and lifecycle summary (German). Confirm dates against the vendor FAQ and roadmap.
